entities.summary: Timur Kulibayev (b. 1966-09-10, Almaty) was a military leader or commander of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Almaty and Kazakhstan. Known in the fields of kazakhstan, merchants & economists, asia.
